---
name: Feature Request
about: Propose an improvement to AgentOS (profiles, standards, tooling, documentation)
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: ['enhancement', 'needs-triage']
assignees: ''
---

## Summary

A concise description of the feature you are proposing.

## Problem Being Solved

What engineering problem or friction does this address? Why is it needed?

## Proposed Solution

Describe the feature as specifically as possible. Include:
- Which AgentOS component it affects (profiles, agents, standards, validator, runtime, etc.)
- Any schema or file changes required
- How it fits into the existing WAT architecture

## Alternatives Considered

What other approaches did you consider, and why did you choose this one?

## Impact Assessment

- **Breaking change?** Yes / No
- **Version bump required?** PATCH / MINOR / MAJOR
- **Affects validator?** Yes / No — if yes, describe new checks

## Implementation Notes

Any technical details, references, or constraints the implementer should know.
